previous_exposure: This window, earlier model quantities, nuScenes labels and prior nonblind associations were already inspected historically. This is not fully blind or an independent held-out sample.

inputs: official SDK annotation projections linked by image SHA
identity_review.method: Freeze aliases-to-instance associations from visible category/appearance/camera evidence before unsealing model numbers. Require unique single actor and at least one valid actually cited image. Preserve ambiguous, group, invalid citation and duplicate-GT rows unmatched. Review every declared actor; never replace the original focal target.
identity_review.prior_association_reuse: Prior labels may guide visual identity, but original model actor IDs are not copied to new responses. New IDs require fresh frozen semantic-view review.
identity_review.historical_front_frame_rule: If no frozen latest-frame projection matches an actually cited frame, either use official SDK projection for that original frame under this same rule before reviewing quantities, or retain unmatched; never add a frame to model evidence.
identity_review.grouping: Initial and revision are repeated observations of one unique window. Missing output/service failure gets its own attempt row; absence of actors is not a zero-error score.

scoring.position: Report Euclidean XY difference only for semantically matching, uniquely associated native values within frozen domain. Reference is annotation-linear interpolation, not exact measured instantaneous truth.
scoring.velocity: No instantaneous-velocity accuracy score from annotation displacement slopes; preserve provided/missing and proxy status.
scoring.road: No road-boundary accuracy score: model local patch has no predeclared correspondence to full-map drivable extent.
scoring.future: Evaluate every declared scenario and all source intervals against complete annotation-linear circumscribed-body surrogate only. Require entire GT body within domain; do not clip. Report coverage, area inflation, missing, gaps, unmatched and no-calibrated-guarantee caveat together.
scoring.planning: Report sealed real tool/acceptor/execution evidence separately. Overlap never implies planning usability.

runtime_separation: Offline GT and identity review only. None of these files or labels are model/T1-T4 inputs.
lifecycle: Freeze this plan before viewing new model metric values. Seal runtime outputs first; freeze identity review next; then evaluate. Do not mutate sealed sources or rerun into existing directories.
new_trial_group: Redundant transport type annotations only; preserve original pilot failure and never transfer its unused call.
preregistration_timing: Prepared before any new generation request or inspection of new metric values; root freezes these files in Git before invocation.
